props.gloss_en: the mishna: [the measure for carrying out] water is enough to rub a kilor [eye salve] with it
Abaye: anything with a common use and an uncommon use -- the Rabbis followed the common one, [even] to be lenient
Abaye: [a use that is] common and [another that is] common -- the Rabbis followed the common one to be stringent
wine: its drinking is common, its healing use not -- the Rabbis followed its drinking, which is common, to be lenient
milk: its consumption is common, its healing use not -- the Rabbis followed its consumption, to be lenient
honey: its consumption is common and its healing use is common -- the Rabbis followed its healing use, to be stringent
water: its drinking is common and its healing use is not
Abaye: they taught [the mishna's water measure] in the Galilee
Rava: even say [it was taught] in the other places -- [water's healing use is common,] as Shmuel said
Shmuel: all liquids heal and cloud [the eye], except water, which heals and does not cloud

objections.gloss_en: אלא מים, מכדי שתייתו שכיחא רפואתו לא שכיחא, מאי טעמא אזול רבנן בתר רפואתו לחומרא? -- by the rule, water should be measured by its common use, drinking, not by the eye-salve
